registered.provenance: Binance USD-M standard taker rate; re-pin against actual contract data in LAB-03

lab_binding.engine_semantic: quantbt endpoint docs: `fee` is a LEGACY ROUND-TRIP fee, converted to the canonical one-way `fee_rate` at the endpoint boundary when explicit `fee_rate` is omitted (v2_fee_rate = fee / 2.0)

cash_identity.identity: equity[-1] - equity[0] == -sum(side * qty * price) - sum(fee), with side +1 for a buy. The account closes flat on the last bar, so there is no open position to carry

verdict.finding: the account is charged HALF the registered one-way taker fee, because the registered one-way rate is passed into a round-trip parameter. The engine behaves exactly as documented; the lab's binding to it does not
verdict.direction: flattering: every account in every phase paid less than the study declared, so absolute returns are overstated
verdict.why_it_was_not_caught_earlier: the engine's default for `fee` is 0.0004, which is also the registered one-way rate, so the call looked correct and produced no warning. LAB-01 recorded the SIGNATURE in api_binding_map.json and never probed the SEMANTIC -- the exact failure the guide's 'never assume a signature' rule names
